name: Nori's Mug
summary: In Dun Morogh, Nori Pridedrift sends a mug of mornbrew to Anvilmar. Travelers bring the drink to Durnan Furcutter, then return the empty mug to its owner.

sections.title: A Courier's Return
sections.body: Nori Pridedrift lends his mug for a delivery through Dun Morogh's freezing passes. It carries hot mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar, where the drink comforts him against the bitter cold. After Durnan drains it, the mug returns to Nori. He reminds travelers that mugs do not grow on trees and expects his sturdy drinking vessel back.

faq.q: What is Nori's Mug used for?
faq.answer: Nori's Mug carries scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar. After Durnan drinks it, the empty mug goes back to Nori Pridedrift.
Nori Pridedrift owns the mug. He expects travelers to return it after delivering his drink to Anvilmar.

faq.q: Why does Nori insist on getting the mug back?
aliases: why does nori want it back
faq.answer: Nori expects the mug back because, as he says, mugs do not grow on trees. He wants his borrowed drinking vessel returned to him.

faq.q: What was drunk from the mug?
faq.answer: The mug held scalding mornbrew, a warm drink meant to ward off Dun Morogh's biting cold.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know a warm drink can comfort you in Dun Morogh's storms. Nori expects you to bring his mug back.
